The test image shows tomato plants that are severely wilted and laid flat. Key features:
- Elongated tan/cream colored lesions/cankers on the main stems
- Complete plant wilt collapse
- Brown/deteriorated roots visible
- No white mycelium visible
- Stem tissue shows external necrotic cankers

This pattern of stem cankers with whole-plant wilt strongly suggests Bacterial Canker And Wilt Of Tomato. Let me view one reference image to confirm.

The reference image confirms Bacterial Canker And Wilt Of Tomato shows yellow-wilted leaves with marginal browning, consistent with the systemic wilt pattern in the test image. The test image's most distinctive features (elongated tan stem cankers + whole-plant collapse) strongly align with this disease. The Bugwood ID 1568040 in the test image is also associated with bacterial canker.
